stemMd: A 60 kg person stands on a scale in an elevator accelerating upward at 2 m/s squared. Use g=10 m/s squared. What force does the scale read?
explanationMd: The upward normal force N satisfies N−mg=ma. Thus N=60(10+2)=720 N. The scale reads the normal force, not just the net force.

distractorRationale.d: This is the net force, not the normal force.
distractorRationale.b: This corresponds to downward acceleration of the same magnitude.
distractorRationale.c: This is the reading with zero vertical acceleration.
